rv.q: With razor-sharp improvisation, laugh-out-loud comedy and outrageous characters, the action shifts nightly based on the audience’s sleuthing skills.
The Greater Boston Stage Company may have just the antidote, opening its 2026-2027 season with Shear Madness, the interactive comic whodunit that delivers a torrent of laughs over two hours.

Landline phones and Olivia Newton-John posters mixed with references to Drake Maye and dead cell phones. Also, there were several killer jokes within the snappy banter that fell flat because some lines felt delivered for rim-shot moments.

cn.t: Critics find this interactive whodunnit delivers sheer fun with strong audience engagement, though the improvisational format occasionally feels uneven. The playful concept and energetic performances earn solid praise.
